text:
- United Kingdom generated £94,054.57 in revenue TW, representing 75.6% of total revenue across all entities and ranking first by sales volume.
- United Kingdom revenue declined 17.4% WoW from £113,921.89 LW and fell 32.0% YoY compared to £138,295.13 in the same week last year.
- Australia achieved exceptional growth with revenue of £16,726.84 TW, up 3954.5% WoW from £412.55 LW and up 4139.0% YoY from £394.59 LY.
- France revenue increased 153.9% WoW to £3,110.18 TW from £1,225.18 LW, though it declined 8.7% YoY from £3,408.23 LY.
- Finland generated £4,418.02 in revenue TW with 2575.0% WoW growth from £165.16 LW, with no comparable revenue data available for the same week last year.
- EIRE revenue totaled £3,676.64 TW, up 47.6% WoW from £2,491.28 LW but down 67.6% YoY from £11,352.29 LY.
- Germany revenue declined to £1,433.78 TW, down 47.5% WoW from £2,728.99 LW and down 67.6% YoY from £4,421.14 LY.
- Belgium showed growth with £984.07 in revenue TW, up 179.4% WoW from £352.21 LW and up 56.4% YoY from £629.02 LY.
